sentences.en: Yogi Berra once said, 90% of the game is half mental.
sentences.zh: 尤吉·贝拉曾说过，比赛的90%是心理因素，剩下的一半是身体因素。

sentences.en: His quote was more philosophical than accurate, but sport and performance psychologists exist because succeeding at an elite level is not just about athletics.
sentences.zh: 他的话与其说准确，不如说更具哲学意味，但运动与表现心理学之所以存在，是因为要在精英层面取得成功，不仅仅靠身体素质。

sentences.en: Now, chances are you aren't an Olympian or a professional athlete,
sentences.zh: 现在，你可能不是奥运选手或职业运动员，

sentences.en: but how many times has someone told you to just focus before a big presentation at work or maybe a big test at school?
sentences.zh: 但在工作中进行重要演示或在学校参加大考前，有多少人曾让你“专注一点”？

sentences.en: In this episode, we speak with a psychologist about how the best of the best mentally prepare to perform and how psychology is helping them.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们采访了一位心理学家，探讨顶尖高手是如何在心理上为表现做准备的，以及心理学是如何帮助他们的。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: Steve Pretenga is a founder of a sport and performance psychology consulting firm called iPerformance Consultants.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·普雷滕加是一家名为“iPerformance咨询公司”的运动与表现心理学咨询公司的创始人。

sentences.en: He has consulted with Olympic athletes on the USA track and field team and is now taking his expertise beyond sports
sentences.zh: 他曾为美国田径队的奥运选手提供咨询，现在他正将自己的专业知识应用到体育之外的领域，

sentences.en: as a member of the American Psychological Association's Coalition for Psychology of High Performance.
sentences.zh: 作为美国心理学会“高性能心理学联盟”的成员。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Pretenga.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，普雷滕加博士。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: Thanks, Audrey.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，奥黛丽。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people have misconceptions about what sports psychologists do.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人对运动心理学家的工作存在误解。

sentences.en: So, you are one.
sentences.zh: 所以，您就是其中之一。

sentences.en: So, can you tell us more about your work?
sentences.zh: 那么，您能多谈谈您的工作吗？

sentences.en: I'm particularly interested in your work with the USA track and field team.
sentences.zh: 我对您与美国田径队的工作特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: What kind of mental preparation is required to perform at that highest level of sports?
sentences.zh: 在体育运动的最高水平上表现，需要什么样的心理准备？

sentences.en: I had the distinct pleasure of working with the team in London in 2012 at the last Olympics
sentences.zh: 我有幸在2012年伦敦奥运会上与该团队合作，

sentences.en: and thought that I was incredibly prepared to get into that environment, had a number of mentors that were there.
sentences.zh: 当时我以为自己已经为进入那种环境做好了充分准备，还有几位导师也在那里。

sentences.en: And the environment of living in the village and being at the Olympics is absolutely unparalleled.
sentences.zh: 住在奥运村并身处奥运会现场的环境是绝对无与伦比的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The pressure is absolutely amazing.
sentences.zh: 那种压力简直惊人。

sentences.en: It would be the equivalent of having everyone in the Super Bowl, all of those teams living together throughout the duration,
sentences.zh: 这相当于让超级碗的所有参赛队伍在整个比赛期间住在一起，

sentences.en: all of the teams in the NCAA tournament living together.
sentences.zh: 或者让NCAA锦标赛的所有球队住在一起。

sentences.en: You have over 10,000 athletes in a very small environment.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常小的环境中，有超过10000名运动员。

sentences.en: Everyone is required to wear their national team gear, colors, logos all over the place.
sentences.zh: 每个人都被要求穿上国家队的装备，到处都是队服颜色和标志。

sentences.en: And so, there's constant reminder that this is something different.
sentences.zh: 所以，时刻都在提醒你，这与众不同。

sentences.en: A big deal, right?
sentences.zh: 意义重大，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: It would be fascinating to see the amount of money that the City of London spent for signage.
sentences.zh: 如果能看到伦敦市在标识上花费的金额，那一定会很令人着迷。

sentences.en: The Olympic rings were everywhere throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 整个城市到处都是奥运五环。

sentences.en: I mean, you could not miss at all what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你绝对无法忽略正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so, the pressure there is really intense, really unique, nonstop.
sentences.zh: 所以，那里的压力非常大，非常独特，而且永不停歇。

sentences.en: And so, to be able to have the athletes and the team and the staff be prepared for that environment was my main job.
sentences.zh: 因此，让运动员、团队和工作人员为那种环境做好准备，就是我的主要工作。

sentences.en: Was it challenging to get athletes to focus in that kind of an environment?
sentences.zh: 让运动员在这种环境中保持专注具有挑战性吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: It's really an interesting process where, for some sports, it's pretty easy to try and have this belief that nothing is different.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的过程，对于某些运动来说，试图让运动员相信“一切如常”其实相当容易。

sentences.en: The 100 meters is 100 meters, whether you're in sixth grade or in the Olympic finals.
sentences.zh: 无论你是六年级学生还是奥运会决赛选手，100米就是100米。

sentences.en: And yet, the energy in that Olympic stadium is absolutely unreal.
sentences.zh: 然而，奥运体育场里的那种能量简直不可思议。

sentences.en: Even being in the stands, you can feel your hair stand on edge.
sentences.zh: 即使坐在看台上，你也能感觉到自己汗毛直竖。

sentences.en: I mean, it's absolutely electric.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那种氛围简直令人热血沸腾。

sentences.en: So, you have to be overprepared to be able to handle that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你必须做好充分的准备才能应对那种场面。

sentences.en: There's so many different distractions that come up in the process of getting there.
sentences.zh: 在通往成功的过程中，会出现各种各样的干扰。

sentences.en: But to really be able to execute, you have to take advantage of that energy and know very specifically, very deliberately, what you're going to do with it,
sentences.zh: 但要真正做到出色发挥，你必须利用好那种能量，并非常明确、非常刻意地知道你要如何利用它，

sentences.en: how you're going to channel it.
sentences.zh: 知道你要如何引导它。

sentences.en: Is most of the preparation happening before they even get to London, or is it happening while they're in the Olympic Village or wherever they are during the Games?
sentences.zh: 大部分准备工作是在他们到达伦敦之前完成的，还是在奥运村或者比赛期间他们所在的任何地方完成的？

sentences.en: Both.
sentences.zh: 两者都有。

sentences.en: Whenever you're talking about any kind of performance, there's a tremendous amount of preparation that has to go into that to be able to rely on a sense of automaticity.
sentences.zh: 无论谈论哪种表现，都需要进行大量的准备工作，才能产生一种自动化的本能。

sentences.en: And the more you have that learned, the easier it is to be able to perform in those environments.
sentences.zh: 你掌握得越熟练，在那种环境下就越容易发挥出色。

sentences.en: Being in Denver, I have a fathead of Peyton Manning up on the wall for the high school kids that I work with with this quote that says,
sentences.zh: 在丹佛时，我为我辅导的高中生们在墙上贴了一张佩顿·曼宁的大头海报，上面写着这样一句话：

sentences.en: Pressure is what you feel when you don't know what the hell you're doing.
sentences.zh: 压力就是当你不知道自己在干什么时所感受到的东西。

sentences.en: And I think there's a lot of truth to that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这句话很有道理。

sentences.en: And that applies mentally as much as it does physically.
sentences.zh: 这在心理层面和生理层面同样适用。

sentences.en: And if we have time to prepare athletes to get to that point, fantastic.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有时间让运动员做好准备达到那种境界，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: One of the interesting things with track and field, though, is we don't have a national team until the plane leaves for whatever national trip we're going on.
sentences.zh: 不过，田径运动有趣的一点是，直到飞机起飞前往我们要去的任何国家参加比赛，我们才算有了国家队。

sentences.en: So in the interim, the athletes are all over the country with different coaches.
sentences.zh: 因此在此期间，运动员们分散在全国各地，由不同的教练指导。

sentences.en: Many of them are at university competing for those teams with those coaches.
sentences.zh: 他们中许多人都在大学里，为了那些教练的队伍而竞争。

sentences.en: And so to try and have consistent contact and interaction and work with them up until we get to the point of team travel is incredibly difficult.
sentences.zh: 因此，想要在团队出行前一直与他们保持持续的联系、互动和合作，是非常困难的。

sentences.en: And there's always a lot of athletes that will do fantastic until they get to an international team trip, and especially the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 总有很多运动员在参加国际团队旅行，尤其是奥运会之前，表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: And something unique will happen there.
sentences.zh: 但在那里总会发生一些独特的情况。

sentences.en: They start putting too much pressure on themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们开始给自己施加太大的压力。

sentences.en: They start to have a little chink in their armor that they've never experienced with before.
sentences.zh: 他们开始出现以前从未经历过的心理防线漏洞。

sentences.en: And so being on site to handle that as it comes up is really important as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，在现场处理这些突发状况也非常重要。

sentences.en: How much do you, and you're touching on this a little bit, but I want to keep going a little bit further.
sentences.zh: 你刚才稍微提到了这一点，但我还想再深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: I mean, how much do athletes' mental state affect their performance, even at the peak of their careers?
sentences.zh: 我是说，运动员的心理状态对他们的表现有多大影响，即使是在他们职业生涯的巅峰时期？

sentences.en: I mean, they've been doing this pretty much, I'm sure, at some point their whole life, right?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，我敢肯定，他们在某种程度上几乎一生都在做这件事，对吧？

sentences.en: Or more than half their life.
sentences.zh: 或者说大半辈子都在做。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: There's a lot of sports psychologists that will go out there and try and put a number on the percentage of whatever sport is mental.
sentences.zh: 有很多运动心理学家试图给心理因素在运动中所占的比例量化出一个数字。

sentences.en: And I find that a very interesting approach because I don't know anyone who's gone to the Olympics with a master's or a PhD in sports psychology and gotten a medal.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种方法很有意思，因为我还没见过谁是带着运动心理学硕士或博士学位去参加奥运会并获得奖牌的。

sentences.en: And if the mental side was truly that important, you would see a lot of that representation there.
sentences.zh: 如果心理因素真的那么重要，你会在那里看到很多这样的代表。

sentences.en: In sports and other performance settings, it's physical.
sentences.zh: 在体育和其他表现领域，身体素质才是根本。

sentences.en: If you do not have the ability to get from point A to point B within a certain time, that mental piece is completely irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有能力在特定时间内从A点到达B点，那么心理因素就完全无关紧要了。

sentences.en: Except that the mental is a huge part of this planning and this preparation and developing, you know, the physical ability, the skills,
sentences.zh: 但心理因素在规划、准备和发展身体能力与技能的过程中，确实占据了巨大的比重，你知道的。

sentences.en: the understanding of strategy that go into it.
sentences.zh: 其中所蕴含的战略理解。

sentences.en: And it's really important to be able to get that out and deliver that consistently.
sentences.zh: 能够将其展现出来并始终如一地发挥出来，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: And if you aren't going to be able to perform at your best, to be able to minimize how far off you are.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法发挥出最佳水平，也要尽可能缩小与最佳水平的差距。

sentences.en: And that is a huge part of it.
sentences.zh: 这在其中占据了很大一部分。

sentences.en: And that's where every athlete will go through different things in their career.
sentences.zh: 这就是每位运动员在职业生涯中都会经历不同阶段的原因。

sentences.en: That idea of pressure will change throughout their career.
sentences.zh: 压力的概念会随着他们职业生涯的发展而改变。

sentences.en: You go through different responsibilities within a team.
sentences.zh: 你在团队中会承担不同的职责。

sentences.en: You know, you're just one of the people on the bench.
sentences.zh: 起初，你只是替补席上的一员。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, you're a starter.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你成了首发球员。

sentences.en: Now you're the team captain.
sentences.zh: 接着，你成为了队长。

sentences.en: Now you're the person expected to carry the team.
sentences.zh: 现在，你成了被寄予厚望、肩负全队重任的人。

sentences.en: You're going to your first Olympics, and it would be great to get to the finals if you get a medal.
sentences.zh: 你第一次参加奥运会，如果能进决赛并拿到奖牌，那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: It's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那感觉妙不可言。

sentences.en: Then somewhere in your career, you're going to your third Olympics.
sentences.zh: 然后，在职业生涯的某个阶段，你第三次参加奥运会。

sentences.en: And if you don't get a medal, it's a failure.
sentences.zh: 如果没拿到奖牌，那就是失败。

sentences.en: Oh, and actually, if you don't get a gold medal, you know, it'll be a bit of a failure.
sentences.zh: 哦，事实上，如果没拿到金牌，那也会被视为一种失败。

sentences.en: And so as your career changes, the expectations that are put on you or that you put on yourself change.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着职业生涯的变化，外界对你的期望，或者你自己对自己的期望，也在发生改变。

sentences.en: A lot of your work now is focused on bringing out the best in children, whether it's in the classroom or sports.
sentences.zh: 你现在的工作重心很大程度上在于激发孩子们的潜能，无论是在课堂上还是在体育运动中。

sentences.en: You're on APA's Coalition for Psychology of High Performance.
sentences.zh: 你是美国心理学会（APA）高性能心理学联盟的成员。

sentences.en: Can you explain what this group is doing?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下这个小组在做什么吗？

sentences.en: You know, psychologists are studying what makes some kids more successful in what they have found.
sentences.zh: 心理学家们正在研究是什么让一些孩子在他们所从事的领域中更加成功。

sentences.en: I think the first part to answer that question is to kind of delve into the psychology of high performance a little bit to begin with.
sentences.zh: 我认为回答这个问题的第一步，是先深入了解一下什么是高性能心理学。

sentences.en: And for me, it goes back to that process of planning and preparing for an event where you're going to be judged, evaluated, held to a standard,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这要追溯到对即将面临评判、评估和标准考核的事件进行规划和准备的过程，

sentences.en: which could be others or on your own, and then being able to get out and deliver what you've put in.
sentences.zh: 这些标准可能来自他人，也可能来自你自己，然后你要能够走上赛场，展现出你的付出。

sentences.en: And so there's a process of really understanding that performance context to make sure you're really focused on the right things.
sentences.zh: 因此，有一个真正理解表现环境的过程，以确保你真正专注于正确的事情。

sentences.en: And there's some truth to the idea that great performance happens when you're not thinking, except that even when we're asleep, we're dreaming, our brains are always working.
sentences.zh: 有一种说法认为，当你不去思考时，表现反而最好，但事实是，即使我们在睡觉时也会做梦，大脑始终在运转。

sentences.en: So it never really is the case that we're not thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们从未真正停止过思考。

sentences.en: We're thinking in a very qualitatively different way, and so you put that together into a plan to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们只是以一种质的层面完全不同的方式在思考，所以你要把这些整合进计划中，从而实现目标。

sentences.en: And yet I know no athlete that can really stick to that consistently.
sentences.zh: 然而，我认识的运动员中，没有谁能真正始终如一地坚持做到这一点。

sentences.en: We're going to get distracted by something in performance, and usually the things that distract us most are things that are related to threat.
sentences.zh: 我们在表现过程中总会受到干扰，而通常最让我们分心的往往是与威胁相关的事情。

sentences.en: It might be threat physically if you're competing in the rain.
sentences.zh: 如果你在雨中比赛，这可能是一种身体上的威胁。

sentences.en: It might be threat to outcome in terms of the competition, the officials.
sentences.zh: 这可能是在比赛结果方面，比如裁判带来的威胁。

sentences.en: And lots of times the biggest threat to the thing that distracts us most is something that's a threat to our sense of self, self-worth and identity.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，最大的威胁，也就是最让我们分心的东西，是对我们的自我意识、自我价值感和身份认同的威胁。

sentences.en: And especially as you see athletes put more of their identity on things that they're doing and more expectations on themselves, they end up putting more pressure on themselves.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当你看到运动员将更多的自我认同感寄托在他们所做的事情上，并对自己寄予更多期望时，他们最终会给自己施加更大的压力。

sentences.en: They're their own worst enemies.
sentences.zh: 他们成了自己最大的敌人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it happens in a very positive way initially, but sometimes we can just get unbalanced in our lives.
sentences.zh: 起初这表现得非常积极，但有时我们的生活会失去平衡。

sentences.en: And certainly within the world of track and field, there are athletes who judge themselves against others based on how they perform.
sentences.zh: 在田径界，确实有一些运动员会根据表现来衡量自己与他人的差距。

sentences.en: If you run faster than me, you're a better person than me.
sentences.zh: 如果你跑得比我快，你就是比我更好的人。

sentences.en: And it would be easy for someone with a psychology training to come in and say, you know, that's just not true.
sentences.zh: 受过心理学训练的人很容易站出来说，你知道，那是不对的。

sentences.en: You should see yourself differently, except in that environment there are plenty of people who do judge others based on that.
sentences.zh: 你应该以不同的眼光看待自己，但在那种环境下，确实有很多人就是根据表现来评判他人。

sentences.en: And the athletes see that.
sentences.zh: 运动员们也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: They know that.
sentences.zh: 他们心里很清楚。

sentences.en: And so it's hard not to internalize that.
sentences.zh: 所以很难不把这种观念内化。

sentences.en: And so from there, I think that general approach to managing pressure is something that kids, particularly today, face all over the place.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为这种管理压力的普遍方法是当今孩子们在各处都要面对的问题。

sentences.en: Pressure to get into college, not just college, the right college.
sentences.zh: 升学的压力，不仅是上大学，而是上好的大学。

sentences.en: Pressure to do well on testing.
sentences.zh: 考试取得好成绩的压力。

sentences.en: Pressure to do well in all of the things that go in their lives, whether it's interviews for college, interviews for jobs.
sentences.zh: 在生活中方方面面都要表现出色的压力，无论是大学面试还是求职面试。

sentences.en: And so I think helping them learn how to manage that is a wonderful skill set, a wonderful mindset for them to develop.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，帮助他们学习如何管理这些压力是一套很棒的技能，也是他们应该培养的一种很棒的心态。

sentences.en: And I think my role is to take their interest in sport and use that as an opportunity to have discussions that they probably wouldn't engage in otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的角色是利用他们对运动的兴趣，将其作为一个契机，去进行一些他们平时可能不会参与的讨论。

sentences.en: And it's amazing how a lot of people in sports psychology have focused on interventions and not sort of this underlying psychological examination of what's going on to lead to pressure.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，许多运动心理学专家都专注于干预措施，而不是从心理层面去探究导致压力的根本原因。

sentences.en: And then there's a number of other areas that really have been exploring the psychology of high performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有许多其他领域一直在探索高水平表现的心理学。

sentences.en: But because we've normally thought of that with respect to sport and they didn't work with athletes, you know,
sentences.zh: 但因为我们通常只在体育领域考虑这个问题，而且他们不与运动员合作，你知道，

sentences.en: we just haven't made that connection that it really is more than just sport.
sentences.zh: 我们还没能建立起这种联系，即这不仅仅关乎体育。

sentences.en: It's performance settings across the board.
sentences.zh: 这适用于各行各业的表现环境。

sentences.en: And so this coalition is our initial attempt to really try and get different divisions, different people together, trying to talk about the things that are going on in our area.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个联盟是我们初步的尝试，旨在将不同的部门、不同的人聚集在一起，共同探讨我们领域内正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And ultimately,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: our big project that we're working towards is to really clarify a psychological understanding of what needs to happen in performance settings and then work off of that to create a developmental model.
sentences.zh: 我们正在推进的一个大项目是，明确在表现环境中需要具备的心理认知，并以此为基础建立一个发展模型。

sentences.en: So as kids are developing, you can have teachers in an academic setting, parents, coaches, understand here is some mental skills,
sentences.zh: 这样，当孩子们成长时，学术环境中的老师、家长和教练就能明白，这里有一些心理技能，

sentences.en: mental characteristics that kids at this age level should learn, can learn, or in some cases are just not ready to learn yet.
sentences.zh: 以及这个年龄段的孩子应该学习、能够学习，或者在某些情况下还没准备好学习的心理特征。

sentences.en: And if we can create that kind of heuristic and checklist for people, I think it will really help bring an appreciation to this part of talented kids development.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能为人们创造出这种启发式的方法和清单，我认为这将真正有助于人们重视天才儿童发展的这一部分。

sentences.en: And I think that's our ultimate goal is to really help performance at the very highest range of what we as people are capable and at the same time helping every person increase their performance,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的终极目标是真正帮助人们在自身能力范围内达到最高水平的表现，同时帮助每个人提升表现，

sentences.en: even if that maximum potential is, you know, just average.
sentences.zh: 即使那个最大潜能，你知道，只是普通水平。

sentences.en: I think some of us have this idea that we're born mentally tough, too, or that, you know, we just need to focus and we'll succeed.
sentences.zh: 我想我们有些人认为自己天生心理素质就很强，或者认为，你知道，只要我们专注就能成功。

sentences.en: But I think what you're saying is that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你所说的是，事实并非总是如此。

sentences.en: There are other factors coming into play here when it comes to high performance.
sentences.zh: 在追求高水平表现时，还有其他因素在起作用。

sentences.en: What sort of advice do you give to kids and their parents to help them face the pressures they face and still be successful?
sentences.zh: 你给孩子和家长什么建议，帮助他们面对压力并取得成功？

sentences.en: I think a big thing is trying to find a sense of balance and perspective in where sport and performance fits in their lives.
sentences.zh: 我认为很重要的一点是，努力在运动和表现如何融入生活之间找到平衡感和视角。

sentences.en: You usually start conversations with kids and trying to get parents involved in that.
sentences.zh: 你通常会开始与孩子们对话，并尝试让家长参与进来。

sentences.en: I have worked with a number of athletes that because they are known as the golfer in high school and that's where they're at.
sentences.zh: 我曾与许多运动员合作过，因为他们被视为高中里的高尔夫球手，这就是他们的定位。

sentences.en: Anytime something isn't perfect in golf, it's just scary and threatening.
sentences.zh: 每当高尔夫表现不完美时，他们就会感到害怕和威胁。

sentences.en: And at some point, it's a lot easier to leave golf than to continue to live with that.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，放弃高尔夫比继续忍受那种压力要容易得多。

sentences.en: I think having them try and get a good sense of what's really important in performance so they really know what to focus on.
sentences.zh: 我认为让他们试着对表现中真正重要的事情有一个清晰的认识，这样他们才能真正知道该关注什么。

sentences.en: And it's amazing to me, in London, at the games, talking to athletes that were on journalists' lists and medal contenders didn't really have a very specific,
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，在伦敦奥运会上，与那些在记者名单上、被视为夺牌热门的运动员交谈时，他们并没有一个非常具体的，

sentences.en: deliberate plan of what they should focus on while they were competing.
sentences.zh: 关于他们在比赛时应该专注于什么的深思熟虑的计划。

sentences.en: If they came to the right thing, they were going to end up on the podium.
sentences.zh: 如果他们抓住了重点，最终就能登上领奖台。

sentences.en: And unfortunately for some of them, they were thinking about the wrong thing and didn't even get out of the first round.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，对其中一些人来说，他们想错了方向，甚至没能通过第一轮。

sentences.en: And so even at that level, they don't really have that clarified.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是在那个水平上，他们也没有真正理清这一点。

sentences.en: It's really easy to say focus and pay attention.
sentences.zh: 说“专注”和“注意”真的很容易。

sentences.en: And I actually think a lot of athletes are really good at it.
sentences.zh: 而且我实际上认为很多运动员在这方面做得非常好。

sentences.en: They're just really good at focusing on the wrong things.
sentences.zh: 他们只是非常擅长专注于错误的事情。

sentences.en: And I think some of the things that we need to focus on to learn and develop and practice are different from what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要专注于学习、发展和练习的内容，与我们需要实际执行的内容是不同的。

sentences.en: And that's where understanding motor learning, motor control comes into play to be able to put that together.
sentences.zh: 这就是理解运动学习和运动控制发挥作用的地方，能够将这些结合起来。

sentences.en: So those are the two big things that I start off with.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我开始时要讲的两大重点。

sentences.en: And then we get into this process of really understanding those distractions.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进入真正理解这些干扰因素的过程。

sentences.en: And I think a part of that comes back to an appreciation of psychophysiology, that in performance settings and there's a tremendous amount of emotion,
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一部分归结为对心理生理学的认识，即在表现环境中存在大量的情绪，

sentences.en: there's a huge reaction in the body that comes with that emotion.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪会伴随着身体的巨大反应。

sentences.en: And I think most psychologists conceptually get that and most people understand the mind-body connection.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数心理学家在概念上都明白这一点，大多数人也都理解身心之间的联系。

sentences.en: But I don't think we really fully understand the interconnection and the pathways from heart and lungs in particular that go up not just to control centers,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们并没有完全理解这种相互联系，尤其是心脏和肺部通往大脑的路径，它们不仅通向控制中心，

sentences.en: but to parts of the brain that are involved in responding to the environment, deciding balance, what's important, what's not in the environment.
sentences.zh: 还通向大脑中负责应对环境、判断平衡以及识别环境中重要与非重要事物的区域。

sentences.en: So we can make decisions, we can analyze it, we can decide how we want to respond and then execute that.
sentences.zh: 这样我们才能做出决策、进行分析、决定如何应对并付诸行动。

sentences.en: And if you have too much emotion and the wrong things going on in the body, it's going to interfere with that process.
sentences.zh: 如果你情绪过激，身体状况不佳，就会干扰这一过程。

sentences.en: And so I think there's some people that focus on the idea of toughness, of sort of ignoring emotion.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有些人专注于“坚韧”的理念，即某种程度上忽视情绪。

sentences.en: And it's great, it's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 这很好，这很棒。

sentences.en: It doesn't affect them except that there's still things going on internally in the brain.
sentences.zh: 这看似对他们没有影响，但大脑内部依然在发生着变化。

sentences.en: So they might not feel that emotion and yet it still has an impact on their performance.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能感觉不到那种情绪，但它仍然会对他们的表现产生影响。

sentences.en: And what happens a lot of times is they're able to perform well, but it comes at a tremendous cost in terms of energy and it's exhausting and it's unsustainable.
sentences.zh: 很多时候发生的情况是，他们虽然能表现出色，但却付出了巨大的能量代价，这让人精疲力竭，且难以持久。

sentences.en: It's not fun anymore.
sentences.zh: 这不再是一种乐趣了。

sentences.en: I think at some point it becomes, you know, just a burden as opposed to, you know, causing elation, I guess, at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 我想在某种程度上，这最终只会变成一种负担，而不是带来快乐。

sentences.en: I've worked with many athletes that are incredibly mentally tough and yet they use that in a way where they're beating their head against the wall.
sentences.zh: 我曾与许多心理素质极强的运动员合作过，但他们使用这种韧性的方式就像是在撞南墙。

sentences.en: You know, they're able to take more pain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们只是能承受更多的痛苦而已。

sentences.en: They're able to suffer more than others.
sentences.zh: 他们比其他人更能承受痛苦。

sentences.en: And so it's, I'm not sure it's the right concept for what we're ideally looking for.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不确定这是否是我们理想中想要寻找的概念。

sentences.en: Switching gears a little bit, there are so many resources now at our fingertips, you know, in our phones and online.
sentences.zh: 换个话题，现在我们触手可及的资源非常多，比如手机里和网络上的那些。

sentences.en: How much is technology playing a role in the application of performance psychology?
sentences.zh: 科技在运动心理学的应用中扮演了多大的角色？

sentences.en: I know it's something that you've really been doing.
sentences.zh: 我知道你一直在做这方面的工作。

sentences.en: I think we're just starting to see the advent of that and the integration of that.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们才刚刚开始看到它的出现和整合。

sentences.en: When you're talking about wearable devices, when you're looking at the integration of sport analytics in sports, looking mostly at statistics to begin with.
sentences.zh: 当你谈到可穿戴设备，当你审视运动分析在体育领域的整合时，起初主要还是看统计数据。

sentences.en: But now as we can look at all of these devices that give us so much data, I think it's inevitable.
sentences.zh: 但现在，随着我们能看到所有这些提供海量数据的设备，我认为这是必然趋势。

sentences.en: In addition to that, most of the athletes growing up that are going to be professional athletes are wedded to technology.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，大多数成长中的运动员，也就是未来的职业运动员，都离不开科技。

sentences.en: I think there's a part of technology that eventually is going to have to come out of necessity because that's what kids know.
sentences.zh: 我认为科技最终有一部分会成为必然，因为这就是孩子们所熟悉的东西。

sentences.en: But I think it allows us to do so much more.
sentences.zh: 但我认为它让我们能做的事情更多了。

sentences.en: We can collect different kinds of data.
sentences.zh: 我们可以收集不同种类的数据。

sentences.en: We can look at what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们可以观察他们的表现。

sentences.en: We can reach them at times that don't involve our office.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在办公室之外的时间联系他们。

sentences.en: I'm working on a project trying to get access to kids through online teaching.
sentences.zh: 我正在进行一个项目，尝试通过在线教学来接触孩子们。

sentences.en: You know, it'll be a subset of what sports psychology can really do and it won't replace people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这只是运动心理学真正能做的事情的一小部分，它不会取代专业人员。

sentences.en: But for someone to have an economical access to this in their own home instead of having to pay a lot of money to go talk to a stranger and the stigma that that might bring up,
sentences.zh: 但对于那些希望在自己家里就能经济实惠地获得这种服务的人来说，不必花大钱去和陌生人交谈，也不必面对可能带来的心理负担，

sentences.en: you know, sounds like a wonderful door opener.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这听起来是一个非常好的切入点。

sentences.en: I have no doubt that we're going to have a lot of people who put the cart before the horse, so to speak,
sentences.zh: 我毫无疑问，会有很多人本末倒置，

sentences.en: that there's definitely going to be some things out there that are going to promise more than they can deliver.
sentences.zh: 肯定会有一些产品承诺得比实际能提供的要多。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Patanga, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕坦加博士，非常感谢您参加我们的节目。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这真是一次愉快的交流。

sentences.en: It's been my pleasure, Audrey.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸，奥黛丽。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: If you would like more information on the topics we discussed or if you would like to hear more episodes, please go to our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 如果您想了解更多关于我们讨论的话题，或者想收听更多节目，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会《心理学谈话》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
